name: Silence the Witness
text: Force or Tradecraft (your team's better one). 2 progress, worth 1 Dominance. When scored: deal 2 damage to an operative.
flavor: She saw the plates on the black sedan. She will not testify.

onScore.prompt: Silence the Witness: 2 damage to which operative?

name: Doctor the Archives
text: Tradecraft or Will (your team's better one). 2 progress, worth 1 Dominance. When scored: look at the opponent's hand; they discard a card of your choice.
flavor: History is a file. Files can be edited.

name: Seize the Broadcast
text: Will or Force (your team's better one). 2 progress, worth 1 Dominance. When scored: Scry 3, then draw a card.
flavor: At 9:14 p.m. every television in the hemisphere showed the same symbol.

name: Rig the Election
text: Will or Tradecraft (your team's better one). 3 progress, worth 2 Dominance. When scored: gain 1 progress on your Master Plan.
flavor: The people chose. They were always going to choose.

name: Steal the Prototype
text: Tradecraft or Force (your team's better one). 3 progress, worth 2 Dominance. When scored: draw 2 cards.
flavor: Lockheed reported it as a fire. There was no fire.

name: Assassinate the Ambassador
text: Force or Will (your team's better one). 3 progress, worth 2 Dominance. When scored: eliminate a damaged operative.
flavor: Officially, a heart attack. Unofficially, a message.

name: Turn the Senator
text: Will or Force (your team's better one). 3 progress, worth 2 Dominance. When scored: ready all your operatives.
flavor: Everyone has a price. His was a photograph.

name: Poison the Reservoir
text: Force or Tradecraft (your team's better one). 3 progress, worth 2 Dominance. When scored: deal 1 damage to each enemy operative.
flavor: Boil-water notices were issued for six counties. Four were too late.

name: Blackout in the Capital
text: Tradecraft or Will (your team's better one). 3 progress, worth 2 Dominance. When scored: exhaust up to two enemy operatives.
flavor: For eleven hours, the most powerful city on Earth went dark. Things were moved.

onScore.prompt: Exhaust up to two enemy operatives

name: Topple the Regime
text: Force or Tradecraft (your team's better one). 4 progress, worth 3 Dominance. When scored: the opponent discards 2 cards.
flavor: The colonels were very sure it was their idea.

name: Crash the Markets
text: Tradecraft or Will (your team's better one). 4 progress, worth 3 Dominance. When scored: the opponent loses 2 progress on their Master Plan.
flavor: Somebody always knows on Thursday what everybody learns on Monday.

name: The Vatican Files
text: Will or Force (your team's better one). 4 progress, worth 3 Dominance. When scored: draw 3 cards.
flavor: Shelf 1,138 of the Secret Archive is not on any floor plan.

name: Cultist
text: Token.

name: Hybrid
text: Token.

name: Contractor
text: Token.

name: Specimen
text: Token.

name: The Morning Star
text: Token. The Adversary, made flesh.

name: High-One Manifestation
text: Token. It does not breathe our air.

name: PsyList Central Station
text: Security 3. Doctrine (Psychic Assault): your Wetwork missions use Will instead of Force, and when you win one, put a Control counter on the target. Enemy operatives with Control counters get -1 Force, Tradecraft and Will. At the start of your turn, look at the top card of the opponent's deck.
flavor: A disused weather station in Nevada. The antennas point down.

name: Project OVERMIND
text: Master Plan (Will). Enacted: enemy operatives with Control counters can't defend, and your Psychics get +1 Will.
flavor: "We are not reading their minds, Senator. We are writing them."

name: Remote Viewer
text: Psychic. When played, look at the top card of the opponent's deck. You may put it on the bottom.
flavor: Coordinates 39°N 77°W. "There is a room under the room."

name: Precog Analyst
text: Psychic. Your Responses cost 1 less.
flavor: She files her reports the day before.

name: Precognitive Flash
text: A participating Psychic gets +2 to the mission's attribute.
flavor: He ducked before the shot.

name: Foresight
text: Look at the opponent's hand. Your side gets +1 to the mission's attribute for each Response in it.
flavor: "You were going to say no."

name: Sensory Deprivation Tank
text: Once per turn, exhaust a Psychic: Scry 2, then draw a card.
flavor: Ninety minutes of nothing. Then everything.

abil.label: Exhaust a Psychic: Scry 2, draw a card

name: Telekinetic Recruit
text: Psychic. +1 Force while another Psychic participates in its mission.
flavor: The spoons were only the beginning.

name: Pyrokinetic Enforcer
text: Psychic. In Bloodshed, its side deals 1 extra damage.
flavor: Spontaneous combustion is never spontaneous.

name: Subject Zero
text: Unique Psychic. When its side wins a mission, deal 2 damage to an enemy operative.
flavor: They stopped counting the orderlies.

do.prompt: Subject Zero: 2 damage to which enemy?

name: Poltergeist Burst
text: Your side gets +2 Force. Deal 1 damage to an opposing participant.
flavor: The filing cabinets went first.

do.prompt: Poltergeist Burst: 1 damage to which opponent?

name: Mind Spike
text: Deal 2 damage to an operative, or 3 if it has a Control counter.
flavor: A nosebleed, then silence.

name: Compulsion Technician
text: Psychic. When your side wins a Will mission, put a Control counter on an opposing participant or enemy operative.
flavor: "Repeat after me."

do.prompt: Compulsion Technician: Control counter on which enemy?

name: Sleeper Handler
text: Psychic. Enemy operatives with Control counters can't defend against your missions.
flavor: "Wake up, Lieutenant."

name: Hypnotic Trigger
text: An opposing participant gets -2 to the mission's attribute. Put a Control counter on it.
flavor: Three words, whispered in 1979.

name: Reprogram Identity
text: Take control of an enemy operative with a Control counter until end of turn. Ready it; it can attack this turn.
flavor: He remembered being someone else. He was wrong about which.

name: The White Noise Suite
text: At the start of your turn, put a Control counter on an enemy operative.
flavor: Room 11. The static never stops.

do.prompt: The White Noise Suite: Control counter on which enemy?

name: Collective Mind
text: Psychic. +1 Will for each enemy operative with a Control counter.
flavor: One thought, many mouths.

name: Neural Link
text: Implant. Attach to a Psychic: +1 Will. When its side wins a Will mission, draw a card.
flavor: The interface was the easy part.

name: Communal Mind
text: Psychic. Other Psychics on its mission get +1 Will.
flavor: They finish each other's sentences. All of them.

name: Mass Suggestion
text: Put a Control counter on each exhausted enemy operative.
flavor: The broadcast lasted four seconds. The orders lasted for years.

name: Prendick Holdings Tower
text: Security 3. Doctrine (Harvest): whenever an enemy operative is eliminated during your turn, create a 1/1/1 Specimen token. Your Mutations cost 1 less.
flavor: Forty floors of glass. Nine more underground.

name: Project CHIMERA
text: Master Plan (Force). Enacted: your Specimens get +1 Force and +2 Health.
flavor: Patent pending: the next human.

name: Security Hound-9
text: Specimen. +1 Force while defending.
flavor: Good dog. Very good dog. Do not pet.

name: Razorback Hybrid
text: Specimen.
flavor: Sixty percent boar. The rest is classified.

name: Alpha Predator
text: Specimen. In Bloodshed, its side deals 1 extra damage.
flavor: It learned to open doors in week two.

name: Prototype Behemoth
text: Unique Specimen. Costs 1 less for each Mutation you control.
flavor: Containment breach logged as a "minor incident".

name: Break Containment
text: A participating Specimen gets +3 Force. After the mission, deal 1 damage to it.
flavor: Somebody pressed the wrong button. Somebody was paid to.

name: Anatomical Reinforcement
text: Mutation. Attach to a Specimen: +1 Force and +2 Health.
flavor: Titanium is a lifestyle.

name: Perfect Skin Graft
text: Mutation. Attach to a Specimen: +2 Tradecraft and Covert.
flavor: It passes. It passes for anyone.

name: Hypermetabolic Serum
text: Mutation. Attach to a Specimen: +1 Force. Once per turn, pay 1: ready it.
flavor: Side effects include everything.

req.why: The Specimen must be exhausted and you need 1 Influence

name: Adrenal Reservoir
text: Mutation. Attach to a Specimen: +2 Force while attacking.
flavor: Fight. Fight. Fight.

name: Mutation Handler
text: Scientist. When you attach a Mutation, draw a card.
flavor: "Hold him down. Gently."

name: Human-Passing Duplicate
text: Specimen. When its side wins a Tradecraft mission, draw a card.
flavor: Your neighbor. Probably.

name: Infiltrator Brood
text: Specimen. When its side wins a mission it joined, create a 1/1/0 Hybrid token.
flavor: They hatch in air ducts.

name: Mimicry Specialist
text: Specimen. Covert. Can't be targeted by Wetwork.
flavor: Wears your face better than you do.

name: Clinical Research Liaison
text: Scientist. When played, gain 1 temporary Influence.
flavor: Her badge opens every door on the 40th floor.

name: Biomedicine Annex 14
text: At the start of your turn, gain 1 temporary Influence.
flavor: Funded by three ministries that don't know about each other.

name: Venture Consortium
text: Whenever you score an Agenda or advance your Master Plan, gain 1 temporary Influence.
flavor: Returns guaranteed. Investors unidentified.

name: Quarterly Earnings
text: Draw a card. If you control two or more Facilities, draw another.
flavor: Up nine hundred percent. Do not ask about the shrimp.

name: The Glass Nursery
text: At the start of your turn, if you control a Scientist, create a 1/1/1 Specimen token.
flavor: Ward 8. The cribs have restraints.

name: Regenerative Tissue
text: Mutation. Attach to a Specimen: +1 Health. At the start of your turn, remove all damage from it.
flavor: Cut it. Burn it. Come back Tuesday.

name: Feeding Frenzy
text: Ready a Specimen. It gets +2 Force until end of turn.
flavor: Nobody fed them for three days. That was the experiment.

name: Dawn Star Grand Lodge
text: Security 3. Doctrine (Blood Rite): once per mission, during Responses, sacrifice an operative: your side gets +3 to the mission's attribute. Whenever you sacrifice an operative, gain 1 temporary Influence; the first time each turn, also gain 1 progress on your Master Plan.
flavor: Founded 1717. Membership: unchanged since 1717.

rabil.label: Blood Rite: sacrifice an operative for +3

req.why: Once per mission, during a mission

name: The Morning Star Descends
text: Master Plan (Will). Enacted: create The Morning Star (8/6/8, Health 8), ready.
flavor: Lucifer means light-bringer. They intend to be very well lit.

name: Ambitious Initiate
text: Occultist. When sacrificed, draw a card.
flavor: First degree. Eager to reach the second.

name: Written in Blood
text: As an additional cost, sacrifice an operative. Draw 2 cards.
flavor: Sign here. And here. And in red, here.

name: Blood Offering
text: As an additional cost, sacrifice an operative. Your side gets +3 to the mission's attribute.
flavor: The altar is never cold.

name: The Lesser Bargain
text: Pact. Attach to an Occultist: +2 Will. At the end of your turn, pay 1 Influence or deal 1 damage to it.
flavor: Cheap power. Expensive interest.

name: The Devil's Ledger
text: Whenever you sacrifice an operative, draw a card.
flavor: Every name. Every price. Every due date.

name: Lesser Imp
text: Demon. When eliminated or sacrificed, deal 1 damage to an enemy operative.
flavor: Small. Spiteful. Bound by contract.

name: Bound Fiend
text: Demon. Can't defend unless you control a Ritual.
flavor: It does what it is told. Only that.

name: Furnace of the Pit
text: Demon. In Bloodshed, its side deals damage to every opposing participant.
flavor: The thermostat reads 666.

name: Pact Summoner
text: Occultist. Your Demons cost 1 less.
flavor: Knows all the names. Pronounces them carefully.

name: Circle of Summoning
text: Ritual. Demons you play are Swift (they can attack the turn they arrive).
flavor: Salt, chalk, and a borrowed heartbeat.

name: Scripture Fragment: Ash
text: Scripture. Your Occultists get +1 Will.
flavor: The first page burned for three hundred years.

name: Scripture Fragment: Iron
text: Scripture. Your Occultists get +1 Force.
flavor: Written on the inside of a sword.

name: Archivist of the First Seal
text: Occultist. When played, Scry 2; if you control two Scriptures, draw a card.
flavor: The library has no catalogue. She is the catalogue.

name: Senior Adept
text: Occultist.
flavor: Thirty-second degree. Still climbing.

name: Grand Master of the Lodge
text: Unique Occultist. Your other Occultists get +1 Will.
flavor: He shook hands with four presidents. They all felt it.

name: The Seventh Circle
text: Ritual. At the start of your turn, if you control two or more Scriptures, gain 1 progress on your Master Plan.
flavor: Below the sixth. Above nothing.

name: Rite of the Broken Seal
text: Gain 1 progress on your Master Plan, plus 1 if you control two or more Scriptures.
flavor: Seven seals. Six already broken.

name: Return of the Faithful
text: Return up to two Occultists or Demons that cost 2 or less from your discard pile to your hand.
flavor: Death is a leave of absence.

name: The Central Committee
text: Security 3. Doctrine (Bribery): during Responses, pay 2 Influence: your side gets +1 to the mission's attribute (up to three times each mission). Your Blackmail missions use Tradecraft, and winning one also gives you 2 temporary Influence. At the start of your turn, gain 1 temporary Influence.
flavor: The pyramid on the dollar is a floor plan.

req.why: During a mission, up to three times, with 2 Influence

name: The New World Compact
text: Master Plan (Tradecraft). Enacted: at the start of your turn, gain 1 progress on a Conspiracy Agenda.
flavor: Signed in Davos. Ratified nowhere. Enforced everywhere.

name: Junior Broker
text: At the start of your turn, if you control a Bank, gain 1 temporary Influence.
flavor: Twenty-four, Princeton, owns a jet.

name: Offshore Holding Company
text: Bank. At the start of your turn, gain 1 temporary Influence.
flavor: Registered at a post office box in the Caymans. So are four thousand others.

name: Cash Transfer
text: Gain 3 temporary Influence.
flavor: Wire it through Cyprus.

name: Buy the Story
text: Gain 1 progress on a Conspiracy Agenda you already have progress on.
flavor: Every newspaper has an owner.

name: Lobbying Office
text: Institution. Whenever you win a mission, put a Mandate counter here. Remove 2 Mandate counters: gain 1 progress on a Conspiracy Agenda.
flavor: K Street. The lights are always on.

abil.label: Remove 2 Mandates: 1 progress on an Agenda

name: Compromised Minister
text: Official. Your Institutions cost 1 less. Your Institutions get +1 Mandate when you win a Tradecraft mission.
flavor: He sold his country once. He sells it monthly now.

name: Special Prosecutor
text: When its side wins a mission it joined, the opponent discards a card.
flavor: The investigation is ongoing. It will always be ongoing.

name: Emergency Injunction
text: The opponent's side gets -2 to the mission's attribute unless they pay 2 Influence.
flavor: Granted at 3 a.m. by a judge who owed a favor.

do.prompt: Emergency Injunction: pay 2 or your side gets -2

name: Public Scandal
text: The opponent loses 1 progress on each Conspiracy Agenda and 1 on their Master Plan.
flavor: Leaked on a Friday. Buried by Monday. Their careers: buried forever.

name: Disposable Fixer
text: Contractor. When eliminated, draw a card.
flavor: No name. No record. No funeral.

name: Contracted Surveillance
text: Contractor. Swift.
flavor: Paid by the hour. Watching by the second.

name: Mercenary Handler
text: Your Contractors get +1 Force and +1 Tradecraft.
flavor: "Who signs the checks? You don't want to know. Neither do I."

name: Corporate Intervention Force
text: Contractor. When played, create two 1/1/0 Contractor tokens.
flavor: Private army. Public contract.

name: Deniable Payment
text: A participating Contractor gets +3 to the mission's attribute. Sacrifice it after the mission.
flavor: It never happened. Neither did he.

name: Executive Protection Detail
text: Contractor. Ambush (can defend while exhausted).
flavor: Earpieces. Sunglasses. No reflections.

name: Municipal Fixer
text: +2 Tradecraft while defending.
flavor: Zoning, permits, and where the bodies are buried. Literally.

name: Hostile Takeover
text: Take control of an enemy Facility.
flavor: The board voted unanimously. The board did not know it had been sold.

name: The First Contact House
text: Security 3. Doctrine (Congregation): you may send up to 5 operatives on a mission. Whenever a Cultist you control is eliminated, gain 1 Revelation. At the start of your turn, gain 1 Revelation.
flavor: A farmhouse in New Mexico. The crop circles started in 1947.

name: The Great Arrival
text: Master Plan (Will). Enacted: create the High-One Manifestation (7/4/8, Health 9), ready, and exhaust all enemy operatives.
flavor: They are not coming. They are already here. They are waiting to be invited.

name: Street Preacher
text: Cultist. When its side wins a mission it joined, create a 0/1/1 Cultist token.
flavor: "They told me the date. It is sooner than you think."

name: Community Outreach
text: Create two 0/1/1 Cultist tokens.
flavor: Free soup. Free pamphlets. Free forever.

name: Ecstatic Convert
text: Cultist. +1 Will while another Cultist participates in its mission.
flavor: She has not slept since the light.

name: Cell Organizer
text: Cultist. Your Cultist tokens get +1 Will and +1 Tradecraft.
flavor: Each cell knows three names. Each name knows the date.

name: Recruitment Circle
text: At the start of your turn, create a 0/1/1 Cultist token.
flavor: Every Tuesday, 7 p.m. Bring a friend. Bring everyone.

name: The Gathering
text: If you control four or more Cultists, gain 1 progress on a Will Agenda and 1 Revelation.
flavor: Ten thousand voices. One frequency.

name: Recovered Probe
text: Artifact. Attach to an operative: +1 Tradecraft. When its side wins a mission, gain 1 Revelation.
flavor: Smaller than a fist. Warmer than skin.

name: Unidentified Alloy
text: Artifact. Attach to an operative: +1 Force and +2 Health.
flavor: Bends. Never breaks. Remembers its shape.

name: Neural Disruptor
text: Artifact. Attach to an operative. When it attacks, exhaust an enemy operative with 2 or less Will before defenders are assigned.
flavor: It hums in a key that makes you forget your name.

name: Contact Engineer
text: Cultist. Your Artifacts cost 1 less.
flavor: Reverse engineering. Mostly reverse.

name: Antigravity Harness
text: Artifact. Attach to an operative: +1 Tradecraft; it is Swift.
flavor: Do not wear it indoors.

name: Whispering Devotee
text: Cultist. When eliminated, gain 1 Revelation.
flavor: She whispers the coordinates. Over and over.

name: Rift Attendant
text: Cultist. Your Entities cost 2 less while you have 4 or more Revelation.
flavor: She keeps the door. She does not decide who comes through.

name: Manifestation of Hunger
text: Entity. At the end of your turn, sacrifice a Cultist or deal 2 damage to it.
flavor: It ate the farmhouse dog first. Then the farmhouse.

name: Gateway Custodian
text: Entity. Play only if you have 3 or more Revelation. When played, exhaust up to two enemy operatives.
flavor: The door is open. It was always going to open.

deploy.prompt: Exhaust up to two enemy operatives

name: Scream Across Dimensions
text: Your side gets +1 to the mission's attribute for every 2 Revelation you have (max +4).
flavor: Every radio on Earth played it at once.

name: The First Unmaking
text: Play only if you have 6 or more Revelation. Deal 3 damage to each enemy operative.
flavor: Unmaking is easier than making. Ask any god.

name: Night of the Lights
text: Your side gets +1 to the mission's attribute for each Cultist you control on the mission.
flavor: Ten thousand people looked up at once.

name: Freelance Investigator
text: When its side wins a mission it joined, Scry 1.
flavor: Ex-cop. Ex-husband. Ex-believer.

name: Ex-Military Bodyguard
text: +2 Force while defending.
flavor: He took a bullet in Beirut. He would take another.

name: Street Informant
text: When played, look at a random card in the opponent's hand.
flavor: Twenty dollars buys a name. Fifty buys the truth.

name: Crisis Negotiator
text: When your side defends successfully with it, draw a card.
flavor: "Nobody has to die today. Probably."

name: Black-Bag Specialist
text: Covert.
flavor: In, out, and the safe is still locked.

name: Mercenary Sniper
text: In Bloodshed, its side deals 1 extra damage.
flavor: Twelve hundred meters. Crosswind. No problem.

name: The Untraceable Asset
text: Unique. When its side wins a mission it joined, draw a card or gain 2 temporary Influence.
flavor: Nobody hired her. Everyone paid her.

name: Silenced Sidearm
text: Gear. Attach to an operative: +1 Force.
flavor: Quiet is relative.

name: Body Armor
text: Gear. Attach to an operative: +2 Health.
flavor: Rated for most things.

name: Encrypted Radio
text: Gear. Attach to an operative: +1 Tradecraft and +1 Will.
flavor: Four layers of encryption. One of them is a prayer.

name: Ambush
text: A defender gets +2 to the mission's attribute.
flavor: They were expecting you.

name: Inside Tip
text: An attacker gets +2 to the mission's attribute.
flavor: The guard changes at 2:10. The camera loops at 2:11.

name: False Alarm
text: The attacker pays 2 Influence or the mission is cancelled.
flavor: Somebody pulled the fire alarm. Somebody was paid to.

name: Tactical Withdrawal
text: Remove one of your participants from the mission. Prevent all damage to it this turn.
flavor: Live to lie another day.

name: Safehouse
text: Once per turn, pay 1 Influence: prevent the next 2 damage to one of your operatives this turn. (Usable during missions.)
flavor: Third floor, behind the laundromat.

name: Extraction Team
text: Return an operative from your discard pile to your hand.
flavor: Nobody gets left behind. Nobody important.

name: Dead Drop
text: Draw 2 cards, then discard a card.
flavor: Behind the loose brick. Third from the left.

name: Leak to the Press
text: The opponent loses 2 progress on a Conspiracy Agenda.
flavor: Page one. Above the fold.

name: Plausible Deniability
text: Your side gets +1 to the mission's attribute, and your participants take 1 less damage this mission.
flavor: Nobody was there. Especially not us.
